scripts.verify:static: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run verify:canonicals && npm run verify:comparisons && npm run verify:internal-links && npm run verify:soft404 && npm run verify:sitemap && npm run verify:review-schema && npm run verify:protected && npm run test:redirects
